Hi everyone,
I am B1 visa holder, I have an account in bank Discount and also credit & debit cards from Cal.
My problem is that I am not able to pay online on websites which require 3d security code (for example - flight tickets of non-israeli companies; international online purchases etc). I called Cal and they explained something vague about not being able to connect security authentication to a foreigner without teudat zeut.
Anyone has the same issue or ideas how to solve it?
